about: The walk test's tour of Home, on its layers (art/scenery/home/layers.json). A stop names a layer's proposed anchor where one fits (build.py takes its point from layers.json) or gives painting px; build.py checks every stop against the walkable floor. A stop with rest 0 is a corner of the tour: the page joins it to the next leg, so she rounds it. The loop passes close behind the low table (where the hand-traced map failed), in front of both cushions, by the armchair, beside the desk and chair, and along the balustrade. Replaces room-home.json's tour (2026-09-13).

tour.name: the lantern moment
tour.why: she walks to the lantern's stand, picks it up, carries it along the table's back-left edge and sets it down at the left corner. Only from table.lantern to table.place: carrying it she faces only se, sse, s, ssw or sw (the holding drawings), and each of those walks toward the camera, so the way back up the page has no drawing. When the lantern is not at `from`, the stop is skipped and the tour runs as before
